Releases are fully automated, according to the project's memory store:

1. Make sure what you want to ship is on `main`.
2. Push a git tag named `vYYYY.MM.N` on `main`. `N` is the release number within that month, so the second September 2026 release is `v2026.09.2`.
3. CI then builds the artifacts, runs the full test suite and publishes the release.

Don't publish packages by hand.

The only source I found is that memory entry. Nothing else in the repo mentions releases, so I haven't checked it against any CI config. I also don't know how `N` is counted, for example whether it resets each month. I'd assume it does, going by the example, but confirm that before tagging.
